summary: Scranton stenographer, daughter of the produce dealer Joseph Notarianni, who married Sal Cognetti in 1943; wife of John's great-uncle.
bio:
Elizabeth Mary Notarianni was born in Scranton on 24 September 1914, the daughter of Joseph Notarianni, a produce dealer, and Michelina Caravia, both born in Italy; her mother came from San Mango d'Aquino, the same Calabrian village as Helen Ferlaino. She was working as a stenographer and living on Providence Road when she married Sal Cognetti, then a soldier home on leave, on 16 October 1943; her father had died three years earlier. The same priest had married Sal's brother Ralph in 1940.

She outlived Sal by four years, dying in Scranton on 20 September 1994, and was buried in Cathedral Cemetery.
